stack_list_of_trees: stack a list of nested trees into a tree-of-arrays using np.stack on each leaf
expand_dims_on_tree: expand a new dimension along a given axis across all arrays in a nested tree structure
apply_fn_over_tree_list: apply a custom function over corresponding leaves of a list of nested trees with None filtering
review_tree_stack: review the tree_stack function that stacks a list of trees with identical structure into tree-of-arrays
summarize_tree_expand_dims: summarize the tree_expand_dims function that adds a dimension to every array leaf in a nested tree
